inputs.lineage: Original USGS producer release linked by the official principal-aquifers landing; HTTP Last-Modified2015 is packaging, not source currency.

title: USGS 2003 Principal Aquifers — unapproved working draft

transformations.preserved: all source columns, physical DBF types/widths, all native Polygon coordinates, CRS, original archive and7sidecars

transformations.gpkg_internal_fid: storage index only; never source or published ID

unsupported_output_formats.pmtiles: Visualization requires reprojection and integer tile-coordinate quantization of native NAD83 double coordinates; full native coordinates/geometry fidelity cannot be preserved. No visualization mapping is approved.
unsupported_output_formats.shapefile_zip: Original producer ZIP, DBF declarations, spatial indexes and metadata preserved under raw/. Regenerated ZIP omits producer .sbn/.sbx/.shp.xml sidecars and is not byte/physical-archive equivalent; output mapping is unapproved.
